title: Divergence: thermite-lower u64_to_string emits LSB-first (42 -> "24"), 07-strings.md REQ-8 mandates MSB-first display

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_numfmt_display_order.rs::divergence_to_string_display_order_msb_first.

AUTHORITY: .design/basis/07-strings.md REQ-8 — 'The surface emits the human-readable MSB-first decimal (the construction is LSB-first; the display form reverses — parse_be(reverse(s)) == parse_le(s) proved ...)'. The Summary names the consumers: the editor's ANSI cursor coords (ESC[<row>;<col>H) and a number formatter/calculator.

TOOLCHAIN: thermite-lower/src/lower.rs emit_numfmt_defs and thermite-lower/src/l1.rs emit_string_runtime_l1 build u64_to_string by pushing (m%10)+48 then m/=10 and return the buffer UN-reversed (LSB-first). The L1 comment claims 'reversed at the end to the human-readable MSB-first decimal' but there is NO reversal in the emitted code.

INPUT/EXPECTED/ACTUAL: forge build a formatter on n==42; run it. EXPECTED (REQ-8 MSB-first): bytes [52, 50] ('4','2' == "42"). ACTUAL: [50, 52] ('2','4' == "24"). Empirically confirmed by running the built binary.

The round-trip proof (parse_le(result@) == n) is GENUINE and non-vacuous (parse_le is itself LSB-first, so a reversed buffer still parses back to n — proven-but-wrong-output). No proof cheat (no assume/external_body/admit). push_byte/from_byte sound (length + non-vacuous element-frame contract). L3 and L1 agree byte-for-byte (both LSB-first) so this is NOT an L3/L1 mismatch — it is the display-order gap. Fix direction: build MSB-first via parse_be round-trip, OR reverse the buffer + carry the proved parse_be(reverse(s))==parse_le(s) bridge.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
FIXED — u64_to_string now emits human-readable MSB-first decimal (REQ-8).

ROOT CAUSE: the divide/mod-by-10 loop builds LSB-first and the buffer was returned UN-reversed (42 -> [50,52] == "24"); the L1 doc-comment claimed 'reversed at the end' but the code never reversed.

FIX (cause, not symptom): build LSB-first (the PROVEN parse_le(data@)==n loop, unchanged), then REVERSE to MSB-first. Surface contract becomes ens parse_be(result@) == n. The proof is carried by the bridge lemma_parse_be_reverse: parse_be(seq_reverse(s)) == parse_le(s), proved by induction (lemma_parse_be_push + =~= extensionality + nonlinear_arith). NO assume/external_body/admit — the reverse + bridge are PROVED. GROUNDED 17 verified, 0 errors.

Files: thermite-lower/src/lower.rs (emit_numfmt_defs: parse_be/seq_reverse spec fns + two bridge lemmas + reverse loop + parse_be contract; GENERATED_NUMFMT_SPEC_FNS += parse_be), thermite-lower/src/l1.rs (data.reverse() in runnable u64_to_string + runnable parse_be), thermite-spec/src/validator.rs (GENERATED_SPEC_FNS += parse_be), plus the two forge test fixtures (parse_le -> parse_be; expected output [50,52] -> [52,50]).

VERIFY: forge check 'ens parse_be(result) == n' -> L3, mutants 1/1, non-vacuous, 27 obligations discharged. Built formatter RUNS: 42 -> [52,50]=='42', 100 -> [49,48,48]=='100', 7 -> [55]=='7', 0 -> [48]=='0'. L3==L1 (both reverse).

GAUNTLET: cargo build --workspace clean; cargo test --workspace 587 passed, 0 failed (incl. un-ignored divergence_to_string_display_order_msb_first + all 5 string_format_conformance); cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo fmt --all --check clean.
